portableAcceptance.totalMeaning: Arithmetic sum of two freshly executed current-version suites, not unique scenarios and not personal handoff checks.

suites.scope: Settings/compact sidebar, automatic persistence, focus, held selection and smooth U/O regression
Original-style three-entry menu, independent difficulty buttons, clean difficulty HUD, recruitment/camera shortcuts and preserved AI behavior

portableAcceptance.scope: Two freshly executed isolated portable-EXE suites; excludes private installation/handoff checks. Settings confirmation counts belong to the settings suite only.

features: The title menu retains three original-style buttons, replacing Credits with AI versus AI. Each side uses four original-style difficulty buttons; strategy and default full difficulty-stat differences remain.
Battlefield overlays retain only the original-style difficulty phrase on each side, without AI prefixes or recruitment buttons.

Space/Enter independently toggle red/blue recruitment once per physical press, including during global pause without logic advancement. These shortcuts affect only the current match and preserve editing/confirmation priority.
P selects compact battlefield overview; the physical Semicolon key restores Follow. IJKL, dragging and minimap positioning enter free observation. Original U/O, wheel zoom and 30 Hz logic remain.

The compact sidebar removes persistent explanatory text while retaining fields, units, actual live values, saving status and action feedback. Three AI categories expose all four random/statistical sets and fifteen counter pools as sixteen-unit grids without a pool dropdown; automatic application, persistence and AI rules remain unchanged.

sourceScan.scope: Public-source privacy scan coverage, not total Git repository disk usage.

privacy.scope: Frozen package runtime audit and public non-ZIP attachments; this later documentation receipt is not part of the frozen package.

localUpgradeSummary.privacy: Aggregate result only; personal values, file names, directories, process identifiers, raw reports, personal file hashes and handoff screenshots are not published.

limitations: 50x/100x and 240 FPS remain targets, not sustained-throughput guarantees; no new full-game Flash-parity claim.
The 271 public EXE checks are 169 current settings/compact/smooth checks plus 102 current dual-AI/HUD/shortcut checks. They do not reuse the previous version's 137/66 results.

The separate 34 private handoff checks are excluded from both public EXE suites. The local upgrade preserved settings and presets, not previous match progress. The prior installation was already closed; no successful automated closing of an old window is claimed.
Semicolon behavior has source tests for English/Chinese key values and actual EXE verification of the physical key; no full operating-system input-method switching validation is claimed.
Published package, notes and evidence retain their frozen build-time documentation. This receipt adds publication evidence without repackaging.
All 45 remote asset sizes and GitHub API digests were checked; no complete remote ZIP redownload was performed.
